verses.1: As they came near Jerusalem and arrived at Bethphage, by the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples ahead.
verses.2: He said to them, Go into the village in front of you. Right away you will find a donkey tied there, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.
verses.3: If anyone says anything to you, tell them, The Lord needs them. He will send them right away.
verses.4: This happened to fulfill what the prophet had said:
verses.5: Tell the people of Jerusalem, Look, your King is coming to you. He is gentle, riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
verses.6: The disciples went and did what Jesus told them.
verses.7: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their coats on them. Jesus sat on the coats.
verses.8: A very large crowd spread their coats on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
verses.9: The crowds walking ahead and those following behind were all shouting, Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!
verses.10: When he entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred up, asking, Who is this?
verses.11: The crowds said, This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.
verses.12: Jesus went into the temple and drove out all those who were buying and selling there. He turned over the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
verses.13: He said to them, It is written, My house shall be called a house of prayer. But you have made it a den of robbers.
verses.14: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
verses.15: When the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did, and heard the children shouting in the temple, Hosanna to the Son of David, they were very angry.
verses.16: They said to him, Do you hear what these children are saying? Jesus said to them, Yes. Have you never read, From the mouths of children and infants you have prepared praise?
verses.17: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.
verses.18: Early in the morning, as he was returning to the city, he was hungry.
verses.19: He saw a fig tree by the road and went to it, but found nothing on it except leaves. He said to it, May you never bear fruit again. And the fig tree withered at once.
verses.20: When the disciples saw it, they were amazed. They said, How did the fig tree wither so quickly?
verses.21: Jesus answered, Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree. You can also say to this mountain, Be lifted up and thrown into the sea, and it will happen.
verses.22: Whatever you ask for in prayer, if you believe, you will receive it.
verses.23: When he came into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him while he was teaching. They asked, By what authority are you doing these things? Who gave you this authority?
verses.24: Jesus answered, I will ask you one thing too. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.25: Where did John's baptism come from? Was it from heaven, or from men? They talked it over among themselves and said, If we say from heaven, he will ask us why we did not believe him.
verses.26: But if we say from men, we are afraid of the people, because they all believe John was a prophet.
verses.27: So they answered Jesus, We do not know. And Jesus said to them, Then I will not tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.28: But what do you think? A man had two sons. He went to the first and said, Son, go and work in the vineyard today.
verses.29: The son answered, I will not. But later he changed his mind and went.
verses.30: The father went to the second son and said the same thing. He answered, I will go, sir. But he did not go.
verses.31: Which of the two did what his father wanted? They said, The first. Jesus said to them, Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and sinners are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.
verses.32: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him. But the tax collectors and sinners believed him. Even after you saw that, you did not change your minds and believe him.
verses.33: Listen to another story. There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a fence around it, dug a place for a wine press, built a watchtower, and then rented it out to some farmers and went away on a long trip.
verses.34: When harvest time came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit.
verses.35: But the farmers grabbed his servants. They beat one, killed another, and threw stones at another.
verses.36: The landowner sent more servants than the first time, and the farmers treated them the same way.
verses.37: Finally, he sent his son, thinking, They will respect my son.
verses.38: But when the farmers saw the son, they said to each other, This is the one who will inherit everything. Let us kill him and take his inheritance.
verses.39: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
verses.40: When the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?
verses.41: They said to him, He will destroy those wicked men. Then he will rent the vineyard to other farmers who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.
verses.42: Jesus said to them, Have you never read in the Scriptures, The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. The Lord has done this, and it is wonderful to see?
verses.43: So I tell you, the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
verses.44: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken. And anyone this stone falls on will be crushed.
verses.45: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his stories, they understood that he was talking about them.
verses.46: They wanted to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowds, because the people believed he was a prophet.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), simplified for children aged 8-12. Faithful to the KJV tradition.
